headline: Two-way NQ structure keeps Tail below block threshold into expiration close
body: Delayed December Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 pricing shows a broad intraday range and a rebound from the session low rather than a persistent no-retracement path. Treasury yields near 5%, negative broad breadth, elevated oil and quarterly derivatives expiration keep Stress extreme. The main remaining conditional risk is a renewed one-way extension into the U.S. cash close.

lookbackSummary: Over the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 25%. It briefly reached the elevated/block threshold during Thursday's late U.S. session, then mostly returned to low/WATCH as two-way structure reappeared. Friday Stress remained extreme around the central-bank, rates and expiration backdrop.
outlookSummary: The highest remaining conditional Tail risk is concentrated around the U.S. cash close and expiration flow. If price action remains two-way, Tail should fall into the Friday electronic close and stay low through the closed weekend, while oil, rates and geopolitical headlines remain reopening-gap Stress drivers.
